approval_basis: User explicitly approved Admin for this identity/workspace and previously confirmed control/ownership of independently managed project
existing_resource_control_basis: Current exact-scope management permissions plus preserved verified resource-group Contributor assignment; application Admin assignment remains based on explicit project-owner approval.
admin_not_inferred_from_azure_rbac: Explicit project-owner authorization is the application role authority; Azure RBAC verifies control, not automatic SSO privilege.
